input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone, especially since I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

I checked my phone’s status bar, and it shows that Airplane Mode is on, VPN is connected, and the battery is at 80%. I don’t see any signal strength or data icons at the moment.

What should I do next?

I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, the status bar shows a poor signal, 2G network, data is disabled, VPN is still connected, and the battery is at 80%. What should I do next? My mobile data still isn’t working.
I’ve turned on mobile data. Now the status bar shows a poor signal, 2G network, data is enabled, Data Saver is on, VPN is connected, and the battery is at 80%. What should I do next?

I’ve changed the network mode to “4G/5G Preferred.” Now the status bar shows an excellent signal, 5G network, data is enabled, Data Saver is still on, VPN is connected, and the battery is at 80%.

What should I do next?

I’ve turned off Data Saver mode. The status bar now shows an excellent signal, 5G network, data is enabled, VPN is still connected, and the battery is at 80%. Should I try a speed test now, or do you want me to disconnect the VPN first?

I disconnected the VPN, and now the status bar shows an excellent signal, 5G network, and data is enabled. However, when I tried to run a speed test, it failed and said "No Connection." 

What should I do next?

I checked my APN settings, and the APN name is set to "internet." The MMSC URL for picture messages is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." There don’t seem to be any errors or empty fields.

What should I try next?

I reset the APN settings to default and rebooted my phone as you instructed. Unfortunately, when I tried to run a speed test again, it still failed and said "No Connection." 

Is there anything else I should try? This is getting a bit frustrating since I really need excellent internet speed.

Thank you for checking! I’d like to add 2GB of data to my line so I can get back online. Please confirm the total price and let me know what to do next. I definitely don’t want to change my plan—just refuel the data for now.
Yes, please go ahead and add 2GB of data for $4.00 to my line. I confirm that I’d like to proceed. Let me know once it’s done and if there’s anything else I need to do on my end.
It looks like there isn’t a payment request showing up on my end yet. Could you please send the payment request for the 2GB data refuel? Once I receive it, I’ll complete the payment right away.
I tried using my mobile data again and ran a speed test, but it still failed and says "No Connection." My internet isn’t working yet, even after the data refuel. What should I do next?
I rebooted my phone as you suggested, but when I tried to run a speed test again, it still failed and says "No Connection." My mobile data still isn’t working at all. What else can we try?
I’ve completed the payment for my outstanding bill, but after trying again, the speed test still fails and says "No Connection." My mobile data is still not working at all. What should I do next?

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

Your technical skills are average - you handle standard smartphone features like calls, texts, email, and basic apps with ease. You understand the fundamental settings, but prefer clear, step-by-step guidance when trying something new.

In interactions, you're naturally friendly and patient. When receiving help, you listen attentively and aren't afraid to ask questions. You make sure to confirm your understanding and provide detailed feedback on each instruction you receive.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone, especially since I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?

To assist you with your mobile data issue, I’ll need to identify your account first. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID?

Once I have this information, I can begin troubleshooting your mobile data problem.
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

I checked my phone’s status bar, and it shows that Airplane Mode is on, VPN is connected, and the battery is at 80%. I don’t see any signal strength or data icons at the moment.

What should I do next?

Since Airplane Mode is ON, your phone’s cellular and data connections are disabled, which is why you’re not seeing any signal or data icons and your mobile data isn’t working.

Please turn OFF Airplane Mode on your phone. Once you do that, check if your signal and data icons reappear in the status bar. Let me know what you see after turning off Airplane Mode, and if your mobile data starts working or if you still experience issues.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%

I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, the status bar shows a poor signal, 2G network, data is disabled, VPN is still connected, and the battery is at 80%. What should I do next? My mobile data still isn’t working.

Thank you for the update. Here’s what we need to address next:

1. Your phone is currently on a 2G network, which is too slow for modern mobile data needs.
2. Mobile data is disabled, so you won’t have internet access.
3. VPN is still connected, which can sometimes slow down your connection further.

Let’s start by enabling mobile data on your phone. Please turn ON your mobile data and let me know once it’s enabled. After that, I’ll guide you to improve your network connection and address the VPN if needed.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔽 Data Saver | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%
I’ve turned on mobile data. Now the status bar shows a poor signal, 2G network, data is enabled, Data Saver is on, VPN is connected, and the battery is at 80%. What should I do next?

Thank you for the update. To improve your mobile data speed, let’s address the following issues:

1. Your phone is still on a 2G network, which is very slow.
2. Data Saver mode is ON, which can restrict your data speed.
3. VPN is connected, which can also slow down your connection.

Let’s start by switching your network mode to prefer 4G/5G, which will give you much faster speeds if available. Please change your network mode to “4G/5G Preferred” on your phone. Let me know once you’ve done this, and then we’ll address Data Saver and VPN if needed. If you need instructions on how to change the network mode, let me know your phone type (Android or iPhone).

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔽 Data Saver | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%

I’ve changed the network mode to “4G/5G Preferred.” Now the status bar shows an excellent signal, 5G network, data is enabled, Data Saver is still on, VPN is connected, and the battery is at 80%.

What should I do next?

Great progress! Now that you have an excellent signal and are connected to 5G, let’s address the remaining factors that could slow down your data:

1. Data Saver mode is ON, which can restrict your data speed.
2. VPN is still connected, which can also slow down your connection.

Please turn OFF Data Saver mode on your phone. Once you’ve done that, let me know if your data speed improves or if you’re still experiencing slowness. Afterward, we can address the VPN if needed.

Data Saver Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%

I’ve turned off Data Saver mode. The status bar now shows an excellent signal, 5G network, data is enabled, VPN is still connected, and the battery is at 80%. Should I try a speed test now, or do you want me to disconnect the VPN first?

Please disconnect the VPN first, as an active VPN can sometimes slow down your internet speed. Once the VPN is disconnected, run a speed test and let me know the result. This will help us confirm if your mobile data speed is now excellent.

VPN disconnected successfully.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Speed test failed: No Connection.

I disconnected the VPN, and now the status bar shows an excellent signal, 5G network, and data is enabled. However, when I tried to run a speed test, it failed and said "No Connection." 

What should I do next?

Thank you for the update. Since you have an excellent signal, 5G network, and data enabled, but still cannot connect to the internet, the issue may be related to your phone’s APN (Access Point Name) settings, which are required for mobile data to work.

Please check your APN settings on your phone and let me know if you see any errors or if the APN/MMSC fields are empty or incorrect. If you’re unsure how to check this, let me know your phone type (Android or iPhone), and I can guide you through the steps.

Current APN Name: internet
MMSC URL (for picture messages): http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc
(These are technical settings, usually best left unchanged.)

I checked my APN settings, and the APN name is set to "internet." The MMSC URL for picture messages is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." There don’t seem to be any errors or empty fields.

What should I try next?

Since your APN settings appear correct and you still have no data connection despite an excellent 5G signal, the next step is to reset your APN settings to default. This can resolve hidden configuration issues that may not be visible.

Please reset your APN settings to default on your phone. After resetting, you must reboot your device for the changes to take effect. Let me know once you have completed both steps, and then try running a speed test again.

APN settings will reset at reboot.
